rule: Split 'SP01 · name' into code and name; map Grab Mart / Shopee Mart to channel App and keep the app name; strip spaces.
reason: The sheet shows the app name in the channel column; the analysis needs three channels.

rule: A row counts as collected when it has a price; rows without a price stay in the table with collected = False.
reason: Weeks 3 to 8 have not happened yet and week 2 has 12 prices missing; keeping the empty slots shows the gaps.

rule: If a date falls in the wrong year but on the right day and month of its week, set the year to 2026.
reason: One row in week 1 was typed as 18/10/2027.

rule: If the quantity was turned into a date (Sheets reads '2.5' as 2 May), rebuild the number as day.month.
reason: The sheet uses the Vietnamese locale; typing 2.5 kg produced a date instead of a number.

rule: If the stock column says 'Hết hàng', drop the price (keep the row, in_stock = False).
reason: A price for an item that was not available cannot be bought, so it must not enter averages.

rule: price_std = price / (qty × factor): g to kg, ml to litre, pieces stay pieces. Tofu pieces count as 0.2 kg each.
reason: Packs differ in size (500 g, 2.5 kg, 10 eggs); only a price per standard unit can be compared.

rule: collector = the name in 'Người thu thực tế' if filled, otherwise the assigned member.
reason: The brief counts each member's share of records by the person who actually collected the price.
Members typed times in three formats.

rule: promo and delivery_fee become a boolean and a number; delivery_fee is kept only for App rows.
reason: A delivery fee on a wet market row would be an entry error.

rule: Flag (do not delete) a price per unit above 2 times or below half the median of the same item across all channels, districts and weeks.
reason: My group wants to check these rows against the photo before trusting them; deleting them silently would hide real price gaps.
